_about: ¡Una más!: Gimnasio Colibrí, two set-ups: the front desk (welcome, form, pay, lockers) and the gym floor (warm-up to the next visit), each with its own first picture from the gym reference. 13 pictures (a long conversation with two twists: out_of_order and hurts).

items.prompt: Mónica, the personal trainer, stands behind the front desk about one third from the left, one hand raised in a cheerful wave, a bright welcoming smile ("¡Hola! ¿Es tu primera vez aquí?").

Change only her pose: she slides a clipboard with a blank sign-up form and a pen across the desk toward the learner and points at the bottom of the form with one finger, smiling ("Llena esta ficha y fírmala abajo").
Change only her pose: she holds out a small black card terminal across the desk toward the learner, its screen blank, a friendly smile ("Acerca tu tarjeta a la terminal").

Change only her pose: she points over her shoulder toward the back of the gym with one hand and holds up a small brass padlock in the other, a helpful smile (the locker rooms are at the back; padlocks are sold at the desk).

Now out on the gym floor of Gimnasio Colibrí (the floor seen behind the front desk in the reference), at eye level among the machines: Mónica stands about one third from the left between a treadmill and an exercise bike, gesturing toward both with open hands, a white towel over one shoulder, an energetic smile ("Cinco minutos en la caminadora o en la bici"). Behind her, along the wall, a leg press and a flat bench with a barbell on its rack; on the right, big windows with palms.
items.note: The second set-up: the first picture of the gym floor; the floor pictures below are edits of it.

items.prompt: Change only her pose and place: she now stands beside the leg press, a white towel lying on its seat, and points at the towel with one hand, eyebrows raised with a playful look (someone may be using it: ask if it's free).
items.note: 5 Nov audit: remade (the leg press with the towel stood in the right third (under the panel on computers) and her own towel was gone) as an edit of warmup (regular API); the audit manifest in the work folder's audit/ holds the prompt.

items.prompt: Change only her pose and place: she stands beside the leg press, which has a blank sheet of paper taped across its seat, one hand on the machine and an apologetic grimace, pointing with the other hand toward a second leg press by the wall in the background with a white towel draped over it ("¡Ay, no! Hoy no funciona").
Change only her pose and place: she stands beside the leg press holding up three fingers, coaching with a confident smile ("Tres series de diez").
items.note: 5 Nov audit: remade (she stood at the warm-up spot, not at the leg press, for «Siéntate aquí, pon los pies en la plataforma») as an edit of machine (Batch API); the audit manifest in the work folder's audit/ holds the prompt. Round 2: her towel put back on her shoulder (an edit of its own picture with machine as a reference).

items.prompt: Change only her pose and place: she crouches a little beside the leg press, one fist pumped and the index finger of the other hand raised, cheering with an excited, encouraging face ("¡Una más!").
items.note: 5 Nov audit: remade (it showed the warm-up spot, not the leg press the learner is on) as an edit of machine (regular API); the audit manifest in the work folder's audit/ holds the prompt.

items.prompt: Change only her pose and place: she stands beside the leg press holding up one open hand in a calm stop gesture, leaning toward the learner with a concerned, caring face ("¡Uy! ¿Estás bien?").
items.note: Also the easy stretching that replaces the weights after the pain (pending id stretch). 5 Nov audit: remade (it showed the warm-up spot, not the leg press the learner is on) as an edit of machine (regular API); the audit manifest in the work folder's audit/ holds the prompt.

items.prompt: Change only her pose and place: she stands behind the head end of the flat bench, both hands hovering just under the barbell resting on the bench's rack, ready to help, a focused, reassuring look (spotting the bench press).
Change only her pose: she holds out a plain water bottle with no label toward the learner, a kind, relaxed smile ("Descansa y toma agua").
Change only her pose: she gives a cheerful thumbs-up with one hand, the towel over her shoulder, a big proud smile ("¡Muy buen trabajo hoy! ¿Mañana a la misma hora?").
